tts_reset_help: Restore speech and the spoken compass to On, with four compass directions.

anchor_instructions: 1. All players involved should start at the file select screen. 2. Come up with a unique Room ID (this is basically your password) and enter it, along with your desired player name and team ID, and select Enable. 3. The host should configure the randomizer settings and generate a seed, then share the newly generated JSON spoiler file with other players. 4. All players should load the same JSON spoiler file (drag it into the SoH window), make sure seed icons match, then create a new file. 5. All players should now load into their game. If using an existing save/seed, ensure the player with the most progress loads the file first. 6. After everyone has loaded in, verify in the Anchor Room that it doesn't warn about anyone being on a wrong version or seed. Team ID groups players together, sharing items and flags. Players who want to share progress must use the same Team ID and randomizer seed. Players on different teams can use different seeds.
